title: Bound EUR allocator-backed variable alias candidate
changes: Trace one allocator pool initialization and bound the examined object stores against the variable byte, including EWRAM mirroring.
validation: Wine e158-byte00-pool-context-literals-wine-cyganob6, e158-byte00-pool-init-wine-vsbrdslr and e158-byte00-pool-invariants-wine-i_i5iqa6 inspect bounded literal references, initialization and loop evidence.
Wine e158-byte00-pool-overlap-wine-q9cpd9yg checks a conditional interval including all byte indices and the runtime EWRAM mask.
limitations: The exclusion assumes the specific pool initialization, successful in-pool allocation, intact metadata and unchanged pointer; it does not prove actual state, other stores, restore, other mappings or ordinary byte00 reachability. Linux, USA and native Windows pending. No performance measurement.
